### Boasting and Humility
Author: Angela Mackey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/boasting-and-humility-encouragement-caf-november-4-2014.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:9
Points:
- Christians are called not to boast in self-righteousness, but in their shortcomings and weaknesses.
- Projecting a flawless exterior hides genuine human weakness and robs God of credit.
- Openly acknowledging personal limitations demonstrates that any victory comes from the Lord.
- Boasting in what God accomplishes through flawed people points others directly to His grace.

### God's Sufficient Grace
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B140919/gods-sufficient-grace
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:7-10
Points:
- God permits physical trials and opposition to restrain spiritual pride and foster humility.
- Persistent afflictions teach believers to rely primarily on God rather than human resources.
- God’s sustaining grace remains completely sufficient even when petitions for relief receive a no.
- Human weakness provides the ideal channel through which Christ's power is displayed.
- Enduring hardship for Christ's sake produces contentment and deepens spiritual usefulness.
